title: RSPO: Regularized Self-Play Alignment of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2503.00030v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Self-play-based policy optimization has emerged as an effective approach for fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), formulating preference optimization as a two-player game. However, the regularization with respect to the reference policy, which is crucial for mitigating over-optimization, has been insufficiently investigated in self-play alignment. To study the impact of different regularization strategies, we propose Regularized Self-Play Policy Optimization (RSPO), a novel framework that unifies prior methods and enables simple plug-and-play regularizers, meanwhile preserving convergence to Nash equilibrium of the corresponding regularized game. We empirically show that RSPO with appropriate regularizers can substantially improve the length-controlled win rate (LCWR) on AlpacaEval-2 across a range of base models, while also achieving consistently superior performance on Arena-Hard, MT-Bench, ArmoRM, and response diversity

translated_title: RSPO：大语言模型的正则化自我博弈对齐
translated_abstract: 基于自我博弈的策略优化已成为微调大语言模型（LLM）的一种有效方法，它将偏好优化构建为一个双人博弈问题。然而，在自我博弈对齐中，相对于参考策略的正则化——这对缓解过度优化至关重要——尚未得到充分研究。为了研究不同正则化策略的影响，我们提出了正则化自我博弈策略优化（RSPO），这是一个新颖的框架，它统一了先前的方法，支持简单的即插即用正则化器，同时保持了对应正则化博弈向纳什均衡的收敛性。我们通过实验证明，采用合适正则化器的RSPO能够在一系列基础模型上显著提升AlpacaEval-2上的长度控制胜率（LCWR），同时在Arena-Hard、MT-Bench、ArmoRM和响应多样性方面也取得了一致的优异表现。
tldr: 提出了RSPO框架，通过在自我博弈策略优化中引入可插拔的正则化器来统一先前的对齐方法并缓解过度优化，在保持纳什均衡收敛性的同时显著提升大语言模型在多项基准测试上的表现。
en_tdlr: RSPO is a novel self-play alignment framework that unifies prior methods with plug-and-play regularizers to mitigate over-optimization while preserving Nash equilibrium convergence, substantially improving LLM performance across multiple benchmarks.
